modifier.description:
Value type modifier

Non empty constraint is specified by adding an exclamation mark in front of the ValueType:
```type
  where: !Location
```

The desire to preserve empty values (such that they can be differentiated from the lack of any value) is specified
by adding a question mark in front of the ValueType:
```type
  approved: ?boolean
```

The non optional function parameter constraint is specified by adding `!?` in front of the ValueType:
```type
  f: function(url: !?string serialized Url)
```

@see #isNonEmpty
@see #preservesEmpty
@see #isNonOptionalParam
@see FunctionParam#isNonOptional

restrictions.description:
The possible value types; cannot be empty nor contain only a single alternate. Note that all but the first
restriction may be an "exclude" restriction.

title:
An "any-of" value type means a list of alternates, any of which are allowed. For example,
`NormTimeseriesDouble | double` indicates that either a double timeseries (vector) or single double (scalar) are
allowed. This is also known as a "union type".

The list of possible value types for an anyof are called its "restrictions". These restrictions must be unique
from an assignability test. For example `int | number` is invalid because `int` is assignable to `number`.
However, `int | string` _is_ value because neither is assignable to the other (although both are convertible).
For the same reason, `any` and `native` are not allowed as restrictions.

If a value being applied to an anyof field could match multiple restrictions, the most natural one is tried first and
then explicit conversion is tried in order (see #isA and #convertValue).

For example, `int | string`:
  * `"4"` will match `string`, since its natural type is string
  * `4` will match `int` since its natural type is int
  * `4.1` converts to `int` (by truncation)
  * `4.1` also converts to `string` (toString)

This means it is best to specify the restrictions from most- to least-specific in the declaration.

Any-of restrictions can also be declared and reused as {@link Union union types}.
name: AnyOfType
